feed_story: Launch recovery with a clear arc: source first, then body proof, then product clarity, with process and CTA spaced to keep the grid premium and wearable.
rules: Never place the same feed_role directly back-to-back.
Use launch context before isolated product selling.
Separate dark/dense digital-source posts with body or product contrast.
Rotate product families and avoid overusing distressed grommet eyelet tank top.
Use campaign/body posts as anchors, not filler.
Prefer real product references and real source files over abstract-only rows.
warnings: The scheduled queue contains many body_campaign repeats; this needs either a missing process/text bridge or broader role variety to fully satisfy rhythm.
Row 1 source pair is intentionally separated by a contrasting product post to fix the palette/density cluster.
Several later rows still lean product/body-heavy; if more posts are added, prioritize text_explainer or process_studio between them.
